desc: Parse input; build mapping f[a]=b for each position; if conflict (a maps to two different letters), print -1.
Validate mapping is a function (out-degree ≤1); self-loops cost 0.
Design graph decomposition into chains and cycles over 26 nodes.
Cost model: chains cost #edges; cycles cost L+1 (buffer step).
Determine buffer condition: cycle solvable iff some letter is not on any cycle; if cycles cover all 26 letters → -1.
Verify buffer check edge case: multiple cycles totaling 26 nodes (e.g., 13+13) must also be -1 since no letter is cycle-free; confirm `cycle_nodes_total == 26` handles this.
Final review of code correctness and mark solution complete.
